attempted_claim: Let 4_1 denote the figure-eight knot and Wh^+_0(4_1) its positive 0-twisted (untwisted) Whitehead double, a winding-number-zero satellite with Alexander polynomial 1. Is Wh^+_0(4_1) smoothly slice in B^4, i.e. does it bound a smoothly embedded disk in B^4?
decisive_failure: The decisive Heegaard Floer chain-level computation (bordered/involutive d-invariants of surgeries on the satellite), any gauge-theoretic obstruction, and any explicit smooth slice-disk construction were beyond this lane's bounded reproducible means, so the smooth sliceness question itself remains open and no claimed theorem is offered.
